title: Somewhat Better Than The Original Version
text:
Somewhat Better Than The Original Version. I bought one of the original mini Keurigs for my husband's office. It was difficult and no matter what water you used, the coffee always tasted terrible. The new mini has at least resolved the flavor issue. It was kind of difficult to get it to work even after following the specific instructions to the letter. I finally had to unplug it, start over and eventually after raising and lowering the lid several times I got it do the first, cleansing brew. It spit and sputtered, groaned and growled, squealed and screeched, scared the crap out of the dog and then finally spit out some water. All in all a very frustrating and time consuming adventure. Put a pod in and repeated all the previous noises and was finally presented with a passable cup of coffee. Fortunately this is going in my art studio for winter use, because if I had to use it everyday I would probably have to shoot it.
I like the fact on this one that I can take out the water reservoir to fill and clean. The pod storage is stupid because you have to take it in and out to make the coffee. Still not a great design, but some moderate progress. Much smaller profile than the original, thinner and lighter for sure.
